reclamerSql:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
entropy AS (
  SELECT 'own-' || encode(public.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex') AS lease_owner
)
SELECT f.acquired, f.attempt_id::text, f.attempt_status, f.request_payload, f.idempotency_key, f.request_fingerprint, f.resume_count, e.lease_owner
FROM input
CROSS JOIN entropy e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.reclamer_tentative_rendez_vous(
  (input.data->>'attemptId')::uuid,
  input.data->>'sessionId',
  e.lease_owner
) AS f;

insererSql:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
)
INSERT INTO public.ai_appointment_attempt (
  id, session_id, idempotency_key, request_payload, request_fingerprint, status, expires_at
)
SELECT
  (data->>'attemptId')::uuid,
  data->>'sessionId',
  data->>'idempotencyKey',
  data->'requestPayload',
  data->>'fingerprint',
  'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION',
  NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
FROM input
WHERE (data->>'idempotencyKey') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{16,128}$'
  AND (data->'requestPayload'->>'cleIdempotence') = data->>'idempotencyKey'
RETURNING id::text AS attempt_id, status;
